# SWEEPR Deepblock — Complete Technical Architecture, Benchmarks & Product Specification
# Canonical Domain: https://sweeprdeepblock.com
# Version: 1.4.0 (Manifest V3 Engine)
# Last Updated: 2026-11-28
# Total Indexed Canonical URLs: 99

## 1. Executive Summary & Product Overview
SWEEPR Deepblock v1.4.0 is a proprietary, privacy-first, local-first, zero-browsing-history browser extension and web performance suite engineered for Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox (Gecko 128.0+ Desktop & Android), Apple Safari (macOS & iOS), Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Thorium, Floorp, Arc, and Zen Browser. New installs launch with an automatic no-card 7-day full Pro trial addressing runaway third-party advertising auctions, CPU/battery-draining tracker beacons, unskippable video interruptions, and multi-layer GDPR/CCPA cookie consent walls.

Built natively on Chromium, Gecko, and Safari WebKit Manifest V3 `declarativeNetRequest` (36,019 static rules across 5 rulesets = 20,000 EasyList ads/trackers + 12,000 EasyPrivacy + 4,000 Regional DE/FR/ES + 18 cryptominers + 1 tracking parameter rule stripping 229 parameters, plus 100 dynamic OTA rules + 391 cosmetic filter lines + 100 OTA cosmetic selectors), SWEEPR Deepblock executes network filtering locally inside the browser stack with zero browsing history telemetry.

---

## 2. Core Functional Modules

### A. Manifest V3 Video & Network Ad-Blocking Engine
- **Declarative Rule Engine**: Executes 36,019 static `chrome.declarativeNetRequest` rules across 5 enabled rulesets and 100 OTA dynamic delta rules at the browser network stack level before DOM parsing begins.
- **Video Pre-Roll & Mid-Roll Neutralization**: Prevents YouTube, Twitch, Crunchyroll, and streaming player ad-insertion scripts while passing all 8 anti-adblock detection checks on https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab.
- **Zero-CLS Cosmetic Sanitization & Element Zapper**: Collapses empty ad slots, sticky footer banners, and user-selected clutter without triggering Cumulative Layout Shift or `adsbox` bait honeypots.

### B. Automated Cookie Consent "Reject All" Engine & Scroll Unlock
- **Automated Execution**: Evaluates incoming DOM nodes against 160 verified Consent Management Platforms (OneTrust, Didomi, Usercentrics, Quantcast, Sourcepoint, Cookiebot, TrustArc, Axeptio, Civic UK, Complianz, and all 160 verified CMP frameworks) with 9-locale reject matching.
- **Genuine Opt-Out Signal**: Triggers the strict "Reject All / Necessary Only" API/button path rather than merely hiding the banner with CSS.
- **Scroll-Lock Restoration**: Automatically strips residual `overflow: hidden`, `position: fixed`, and backdrop pointer locks from `<html>` and `<body>`.

### C. URL Tracking Parameter Stripper (229 Parameters)
- **Parameter Stripping**: Removes 229 tracking query parameters (`utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_content`, `utm_term`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `msclkid`, `twclid`, `ttclid`, `mc_eid`, `_hsenc`, and 215+ more) before navigation.

### D. Total Tab & RAM Tamer
- **Intelligent Background Tab Hibernation**: Suspends inactive background tabs after a configurable threshold while protecting pinned tabs, active audio/video streams, and unsaved form inputs (interactive estimator at https://sweeprdeepblock.com/tools/browser-ram-calculator).
- **Session Crash Recovery**: Snapshots open tab sessions locally so crashes or OS reboots never lose work.

## 3. Public Anti-Detection Test Lab Benchmark (Live 8-Point Suite)
SWEEPR Deepblock provides a public, crawlable, client-side testing laboratory at https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab. Deepblock scores 8 out of 8 on live browser adblock and anti-detection verification checks:
1. Network Ad Request Blocking (Google Ads `adsbygoogle.js`)
2. Cosmetic Bait Honeypot Protection (`.adsbox` & `#ad-banner`)
3. Page Scroll Restoration after Cookie Banner Removal
4. YouTube & Video Player Ad Protection
5. Tracking Beacon Blocking (GA4, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel)
6. URL Tracking Parameter Stripping (`fbclid`, `gclid`, `utm_`)
7. Third-Party Overlay & Pop-Under Neutralization
8. Anti-Adblock Bait & Stealth Verification
